visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and glasses, wearing a purple sweater, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. She holds a metal tray filled with various bagels (plain and chocolate-seeded) toward the camera. Behind her is a white tile backsplash and wooden shelves holding jars and plants. (2) Multiple miniature versions of the woman appear in front of her, dancing and gesturing. She shifts between different trays of bagels as white captions appear. The lighting is warm and natural. (3) A close-up shows hands rummaging through a bag of metallic piping tips. Small, cut-out versions of the woman are edited to stand on the tips. She later holds a grey tabby cat in the air against a background of scattered piping tips. (4) The scene shifts to the woman organizing ingredients. She places bags of white powder into a clear plastic bin. A cream-colored, retro-style label printer is introduced on a counter. (5) The printer dispenses a white label. A miniature version of the woman stands next to it, pointing. Close-up shots show labeled plastic containers of flour and jars of ingredients being placed on a white countertop. (6) The woman packs bagels into small plastic bags. She uses a smartphone interface to design custom labels with icons. The printer produces a label that is then stuck onto the bagel packaging. (7) She opens a stainless steel freezer drawer and arranges the labeled bagel bags inside. A demonstration shows her placing a labeled container under a running faucet to show water resistance. (8) She opens a messy drawer filled with paper manuals. Using a smartphone, she scans a QR code printed on a label. The screen shows a digital manual and later a recipe website. (9) The woman interacts with the cat again on a light-colored sofa, sticking a small label onto the cat's fur as a playful gesture. The printer is shown in close-up again, highlighting its 300dpi capability.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking Mandarin, accompanied by an upbeat, synth-driven pop BGM with a strong, 128 BPM electronic beat. A subtle digital 'ding' SFX marks the start. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs at the 5-second mark as the speaker introduces the first problem. The vocal delivery is rapid and enthusiastic. (3) A realistic cat 'meow' SFX is integrated around the 8-second mark, followed immediately by a whimsical 'pop' sound effect as miniature graphics appear. (4) A rhythmic mechanical 'whirring' and 'clicking' sound of a printer is heard at 11 seconds, layered clearly over the BGM. (5) At 40 seconds, a distinct sound of rushing water and scrubbing is heard, matching a demonstration of the label's durability. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo. (6) A digital UI 'click' or camera shutter sound is audible at 45 seconds when a phone scans a QR code. (7) The video concludes with the speaker's tone becoming playful and humorous, ending with a final bright electronic chime SFX.
